name: Miguel Delgado
bio: Passionate and adaptable software developer with hands-on experience in developing diverse applications. I enjoy learning new technologies and constantly look for ways to improve my skills. I thrive in collaborative environments, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams, and value teamwork to deliver high-quality solutions.

bullets: Collaborated with cross-functional teams to plan and develop internal business applications.
Contributed to frontend development with Angular and React, and backend development with .NET and PHP to optimize internal processes.
Worked closely with stakeholders to align technical solutions with company goals.
Developed front-end interfaces with React, Next.js, and Astro, applying Clean Code principles and development best practices.
Worked with Back-End, UI/UX, QA, and Product teams to ensure the quality and functionality of delivered work.
Actively participated in Scrum methodology, contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and follow-up.
Stayed current through courses and continuous learning of modern development technologies and tools.
